content: The bird that perches on a branch is never terrified of the twig snapping beneath it, for its trust is not in the wood, but in its own wings.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Classical Persian Folk Aphorisms & Sufi Precepts
explanation: If your security is tied entirely to external props—a particular job title, an employer's favor, a bank account—you will live in chronic dread of the branch snapping. True peace is discovered when your faith rests in your God-given resilience, character, and inner wings.
practicalInsight: Remind yourself that whatever external changes occur, your inner adaptability and resilience are always with you.
reflectionPrompt: Are you placing your security in a fragile external branch, or in the strength of your own inner wings?
